fixed.explanation: runDaemonForContext called browser.bind for every new context, and the second bind throws because a browser server is already running. The fix records bound browsers in a WeakSet. Later contexts on the same browser skip the bind, the console message and the pause, so the browser is exposed once. The function returns false for those contexts. I couldn't see its callers, so I assumed false is the right value there.
